name: Chicken cauliflower fried rice
summary: Grated cauliflower stir-fried like fried rice with chicken, egg, carrot, red pepper, baby marrow and spring onion, seasoned with garlic, ginger and tamari.
about: Fried rice began in Chinese home kitchens as a way to use up cooked rice. Grating cauliflower to stand in for the rice is a swap low-carb and banting cooks use, and the egg, chicken, ginger and soy keep the take-away flavour on a one-pan weeknight supper.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.note: beaten with a pinch of salt

ingredients.name: Spring onions
ingredients.note: sliced, white and green parts kept apart

ingredients.name: Tamari
ingredients.note: a soy sauce brewed without grain, from the Asian shelf

steps: Cut the cauliflower into florets, discarding the leaves and the hard core. Pulse in a food processor in two batches, 8 to 10 short pulses each, until it looks like rice; or grate it on the coarse side of a box grater. Stop before it turns to crumbs.
Heat a large wok or deep frying pan over medium heat with 1 tsp of the oil. Pour in the eggs and stir gently for about 1 minute, until just set in soft pieces. Tip onto a plate.

Turn the heat to high and add 1 tbsp of the oil. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes without moving it, then stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes more, until golden and white all the way through. Lift onto the plate with the egg.

Add the remaining oil with the carrot, red pepper, baby marrows and the white parts of the spring onions. Stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes, until the carrot is starting to soften. Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the cauliflower, spread it over the pan and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring every minute, until hot and just tender with no raw crunch; do not cook it longer or it turns soft and wet.

Return the chicken and egg, pour over the tamari and toss over high heat for 1 minute until everything is hot and evenly coloured. Stir in the spring onion greens, lemon juice and pepper, taste for salt and serve straight away.
prepNote: Rice the cauliflower and chop the vegetables up to a day ahead; keep them in a covered bowl in the fridge.
